findings.issue: No unit tests despite a complete Vitest setup: vitest+jsdom devDeps, tsconfig.spec.json, @angular/build:unit-test target in angular.json, and an 'ng test' script — all unused.
findings.suggestion: Add spec files for the pure logic first (format.ts, compareRows/buildTables, catalog assembly, parseQuery), using the already-wired unit-test builder.

findings.issue: Search/type/generation filtering, pagination clamping and URL round-tripping are entirely untested; the spec's URL-state requirements (page reset on filter change, omitted defaults) have subtle edge cases.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test parseQuery/pageLink/filtered computed with a small in-memory catalog, asserting rendered counts and query params, not internals.

findings.issue: get() caches the shareReplay observable before it completes, so an errored request is cached and replayed to all future subscribers for the session — a latent bug no test would currently catch.
findings.suggestion: Write a cached-error test (HttpTestingController / mocked HttpClient) and evict failed entries from the cache so retries are possible.

findings.issue: Move-table sorting rules (nulls last in both directions, Level Up by level-then-name, method priority then alphabetical) and toggleSort's direction flip are untested; each is easy to break in a refactor.
findings.suggestion: Extract or directly test compareRows/buildTables with fixture rows covering null power/accuracy/pp and all method orders.

findings.issue: Alternate-form exclusion (id <= 10000), slot-order sorting and generation membership mapping are untested; a data-layer refactor regresses every list page at once.
findings.suggestion: Test CatalogService against small mocked API responses including an id > 10000 entry and a species in two generations.

findings.issue: Game-selection default (highest order) and ?game= URL handling, including fragment preservation in onGameChange, have no regression guard.
findings.suggestion: Add a test that a ?game= param selects that group and that the default is the highest-order group.

findings.issue: The humanize/padDex/latestEnglishFlavor/collapseWhitespace helpers — the cheapest, highest-value unit targets in the repo — are untested; em-dash displayValue and 4-digit padding regress silently.
findings.suggestion: A single spec file of table-driven cases for all helpers.

findings.issue: Loading-vs-missing race handling (species === undefined guards around title effects) is untested; adding toSignal initialValue: null would flash 'Not found – Pokédex' on every load.
findings.suggestion: Cover with a component test asserting the title sequence while the species request is in flight.

findings.issue: README claims 'ng test' executes unit tests, but there are none — misleading for the next maintainer.
findings.suggestion: Either add the tests or remove the claim.

summary: The app contains no tests of its own despite Vitest, jsdom, a spec tsconfig and a unit-test builder target all being wired up and even documented in the README. All filtering, pagination, URL-state, sorting and catalog-assembly logic — the bulk of the codebase — is guarded only by the acceptance suite. Once that suite is gone, any data-layer refactor lands blind, and one latent bug (permanently cached failed HTTP requests in ApiService) is waiting precisely in that blind spot.
